item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - (Re-up) voiceless versions of Drake and Josh Go Hollywood and 3 Season 4 episodes
item.description:
So this thread: https://sharemania.us/threads/drake-josh-voiceless-episodes-collection-480p-teennick-mega.139737/, is missing 4 things it claims have: the voiceless version of Drake and Josh Go Hollywood and these three episodes from Season 4: My Dinner With Bobo, Tree House and Megan's Revenge.

I even commented on that thread to reupload those 4 but never did so.
DavidAnt123 said: ↑
Can you please reupload the "Drake and Josh Go Hollywood" one as well as the ones for "My Dinner With Bobo", "Tree House" and "Megan's Revenge"? I'm not seeing them in the folder.
Click to expand...
On YouTube, a user by the name of RandomBendyFan uploaded a clip from the voiceless version of "Go Hollywood", that being of the song 'Don't Preach'. I reached out to him on Reddit (which he goes by the username "RBF" or "WildPepper-1596") where he upload the same thing and asked him in the comments to send/DM me a link to the full voiceless version of "Go Hollywood" and he said that "The file got deleted after [he] downloaded it and [he hasn't] got enough storage to put it on Google Drive. Sorry."

So if anyone has a copy of the voiceless version of Go Hollywood and those 3 Season 4 episodes, please DM me a link.
item.author: DavidAnt123
